ownerReview.api: PASS. The two methods use existing canonical types: inspectPending(accountRef) returns readonly ModelAdmissionRecordV1 rows; resumePending(accountRef, callKey) returns one existing record. No new DTO, queue table or migration is introduced.
ownerReview.eligibleRows: PASS FOR ADR SCOPE. pendingPredicate restricts to same-account/current-UTC-day uncharged denied rows with zero native sends, no terminal acknowledgement, no end time, non-null retryAt, measured threshold/OPTIONAL_WORK_PAUSED reason, and event/continuation/quiet-tick/repair/replay classes. SQL orders event/continuation, quiet-tick, repair/replay.
ownerReview.sameRowTransition: PASS. resume_row updates only the selected denied, uncharged, unended row with native_send_count=0 to reserved/charged/leased while preserving frozen request/cost/hash/day and native fields. Existing constraints allow reserved only with lease active and native count zero; the guard permits false-to-true charge but prohibits uncharging, settled mutation and binding changes.
ownerReview.budgetCharge: PASS. budget_charge consumes only resume_row RETURNING. The conditional denied-and-uncharged update is the sole transition that makes that row chargeable; changed-row retries return the persisted record before mutation, so they cannot increment again.
ownerReview.replayAndUncertain: PASS. The early return covers reserved, sending, uncertain, settled, and any charged row including charged-denied; these are readbacks only. Uncertain/charged rows are excluded from pending selection and no charge can be reclaimed.
ownerReview.atomicHeadGuard: PASS. Both fresh-reserve and resume paths recheck the expected pending head in the mutation CTE under the existing pg_advisory_xact_lock(18374691), together with snapshot/budget guards. Fresh lower-priority reserve is persisted as uncharged OPTIONAL_WORK_PAUSED with the pending head retryAt.

probeFindings.detail: At 58%, the phase resumes and settles only event/continuation, then observes 59.998% and proves quiet-tick is vetoed while repair remains denied. It never resumes quiet-tick at a headroom state where quiet-tick is eligible and repair stays held. Thus the repair-first part is inferred from queue order, not shown as quiet work proceeding while repair pauses.

Fresh event and continuation are checked as eligible at 59%; the phase ends with quiet/repair pending. It never checks a later common-window headroom where event and continuation are themselves deferred after quiet/repair remain held. The phase has no final high-priority denial, uncharged/no-lease/native-count-zero/wake assertion. Add final event and continuation attempts whose existing shared usage, outstanding upper bounds and request bounds reach the common 60/70 equality veto, then read back their deferred rows ahead of quiet/repair.

Wrong-head noWrongMutation compares only call IDs and ledger; fresh-hold preserved checks only that previous IDs remain, plus fallbackJobsReserved. A same-ID decision/retryAt/charge/lease/native-field mutation could pass. Compare each preexisting canonical ModelAdmissionRecordV1 with its post-operation readback (exact array equality for wrong-head, by-ID full-record equality for the fresh reserve), alongside the ledger.

scopeNotes.policy: No new per-class percentages or reserve fractions found. The owner reuses ModelAdmissionPolicy and measured request bounds.
scopeNotes.dayBoundary: ADR explicitly scopes this proof to same-UTC-day measured-threshold retries; cross-day retry relationships remain deferred because utc_day is immutable.
